data.narrative:
Dream Security, a Series B defense and security company founded by Shalev Hulio, Sebastian Kurz, and Gil Dolev, has raised over $100M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparables: 2 public firms (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private-stage companies operating in the same sector.

Stage-progression analysis was not applicable. The reported $3.0B post-money valuation implies a step-up to $5.7B, which exceeds 20x total capital raised and appears to reflect a data parsing error; this method was excluded from triangulation. Peer-median valuation proved the reliable approach. Across 6 same-sector, same-stage private comparables—Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B)—the median valuation is $1.0B, with a range of $300M to $1.4B.

This single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a central estimate of $1.0B. The narrow peer dispersion around the median suggests reasonable market consensus for Series B defense companies, though valuation certainty is constrained by limited public comparables and sector-specific execution risks inherent to defense technology. Key uncertainties include customer concentration, regulatory environment shifts, and competitive positioning within the peer set.
